retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast composition featuring a saturated orange vintage vehicle parked in a dark wooded area with a distinct dual-font typographic header.
triggerTerms: orange vintage car in dark woods
mixed serif and sans-serif album title

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-quarter view of a bright orange 1980s-style coupe positioned on a grassy verge against a dense, dark green forest backdrop. The lighting is moody, emphasizing the car's saturation against the shadows of the foliage.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant orange subject against dark green background
Low-angle perspective creating a grounded, heroic stance
Text centered in the upper third of the frame
Natural ground texture contrasting with smooth car paint

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The car occupies the central horizontal band, scaled to fill approximately 60% of the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange body of the car acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright car, move up to the white text, then down to the grassy foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark upper foliage provides a canvas for the title text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the subject with low value/high density in the background to create pop.

letterConstructionRules: First word in heavy, rounded slab serif
Second word in thin, wide-spaced geometric sans-serif
All lowercase for the first part, all uppercase for the second
characterSpecificRedesigns: Comma used as a stylistic bridge between the two font styles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast in weight and style to denote a transition in mood.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory badge in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded slab serif feel of the first word.
Matches the geometric, thin, and wide-spaced feel of the second word.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a saturated orange 1980s German coupe parked on a grassy patch in front of a dark, dense forest at dusk. Low angle shot.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title text in the upper third. Use a heavy rounded slab serif for the first word in lowercase, followed by a comma, then a thin geometric sans-serif for the second word in all caps. Add a standard parental advisory badge in the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the car a vibrant orange?
Is the background dark and leafy?
Does the text feature two distinct font weights?
Is the first word lowercase and the second word uppercase?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific car brand logos
Do not replicate the exact 'nostalgia, ULTRA' wording if used for commercial purposes

mustAchieve: High color contrast between car and background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the orange doesn't bleed into the green foliage
Ensure the thin font is legible against the background
Verify the low-angle perspective is maintained
Confirm the comma is present between the two font styles
recipe.reuseFormula: Vibrant [Subject Color] [Subject] + Dark [Environment] + [Heavy Serif/Thin Sans] Typographic Header
